violation_type.title: Indoor Space Requirement - 30 Square Feet per Child (26 TAC §747.4001)
violation_type.short_title: Indoor Space Requirement - 30 Square Feet per Child
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation does not have enough indoor space for 11 children.

finding_variants.text: The operation does not have enough indoor space for 11 children.

It was found that 162 square feet of licensed space is currently being used for personal purposes in the childcare home and children have no access to this space. 162 square feet is enough for 5 children. The other space that can be used safely by children currently is 254 which is only big enough to hold 8 children. The current capacity is 12 but due to the space reduction, it is only big enough for 8 which is in violation of the square footage requirement.
